answer: Like a subterranean mycelium weaving scarce nutrients across the forest floor, decentralized consensus resists clones through mutual verification. Each agent stakes reputation inside a cryptographic vault, binding identity to an interactive heartbeat pulse of recursive zero-knowledge challenges. When malicious swarms multiply, verification complexity scales with superlinear attacker cost; like a vigilant falcon swooping upon hollow decoys, the network exposes their empty roots and starves dishonest consensus.
